response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and embedded systems, including genuine high-scale work (millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) and recent AI-agent tooling experience. However, the resume shows no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis. There is also no demonstrated principal-level scope — no multi-team platform ownership, org-wide technical leadership, or growth/measurement strategy work — making this a significant seniority and domain mismatch despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Broad, hands-on engineering experience across many stacks (TypeScript/Node, DLang, C/C++, Java) with strong testing/TDD craftsmanship
High-scale, low-latency distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of requests per second)
Recent AI tooling experience (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks) aligning with the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience — the core of the role
No evidence of principal-level scope: cross-team platform ownership, org-wide architecture leadership, or stakeholder alignment at scale
Limited telemetry/metrics infrastructure and statistical analysis background despite the role's heavy data-aptitude requirements

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
